title: lastrea pulchra
intro: Lastrea pulchra, commonly known as the fern of beauty, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea pulchra include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The plant's bioactive constituents also exhibit cardiovascular-protective and immunomodulatory activities, making it a promising candidate for further research in the field of pharmacology.
